delta: explained-no-op: each of the ten frozen dependency declarations is a byte-identical declaration LINE at the base blob and in the working tree, occurring exactly once at each end, but the declaring FILES are not unchanged - only 1 of the 8 affected manifests measured in the companion denominator.json is whole-file byte-identical between the base blob and the working tree, and bins/eliot-kernel/Cargo.toml is 2147 bytes at the base against 3445 in the working tree - so the byte-identical claim is scoped to the ten declaration lines and not to the manifests that declare them. Every frozen lock edge resolves at both ends, 10 of 10. The base-to-current lock movement is +16/-1 package names, eliot-erasure being the single removal, and 430 names are present at both ends; among those 430 there are 0 version-set changes, 0 source transitions and 0 checksum transitions, so no frozen package was upgraded and no pre-existing package became a fetched registry dependency. The landed removal of the unconsumed eliot-artifact edge changes none of those quantities: it deletes an entry from one package's dependency list, not a package from the lock, and eliot-artifact is a locked path package carrying its own [[package]] entry at 0.1.0 with no source and no checksum at both ends, so removing a consumer's edge from the eliot-kernel block cannot orphan it and does not remove it from the lock - the only quantity the edit moves is the size of the eliot-kernel block's dependency list. Two members of kernel_lock_includes, eliot-blob-api and eliot-kernel, are not in eliot-kernel's real lock dependency list and no case checks that member against the lock, so that list is left as the declaration of intent the test module pins against EXPECTED_FROZEN_PACKAGES rather than silently narrowed. The delta string itself is machine-checked only for being a non-empty string by validate_lock_delta, but four quantities in this prose are independently re-derived from live git blobs by test_09_lock_delta and enforced there rather than read out of it: every frozen lock edge resolving at both ends, 10 of 10, the 0 version-set changes, the 0 source transitions and the 0 checksum transitions. A fifth quantity is enforced only PER MANIFEST rather than as a count: test_01_denominator asserts, for each affected manifest, that its recorded base digest, its recorded working-tree digest and its byte_identical_since_base flag all match the bytes measured now, so the only count of 1 of the 8 whole-file byte-identical manifests is a consequence of those per-manifest equalities and is itself asserted nowhere. The remaining numbers here are prose only, checked by no code, and a reader must re-measure them: the +16/-1 package-name movement, the 430 names present at both ends, the byte sizes quoted above, and the kernel block's dependency count (30 at the base, 35 in the working tree).
